artworks.title: Blind Orion Searching for the Rising Sun
artworks.description: Poussin's Met landscape for the Metropolitan Museum: the Lemnian guide Cedalion rides on blind Orion's shoulders toward the dawn that will heal the hunter's sight — Cedalion as the small figure who steers the giant.

popCulture.title: Cedalion
popCulture.description: Hephaestus' servant on Lemnos who guides blinded Orion to the sunrise — Hyginus' astronomer-myth of restored sight.

popCulture.title: Blind Orion Searching for the Rising Sun
popCulture.creator: Nicolas Poussin
popCulture.description: The painting that made Cedalion visible to modern viewers — Orion as a walking mountain, the guide perched on his shoulders.

popCulture.title: Orion (mythology)
popCulture.description: The blinded hunter who carries Cedalion to the east — Cedalion's fame is almost entirely this episode.
